counting_scope: 680 completed independent physical-path exports; coordinate count is not independent hypotheses or trials; development fixtures and incomplete exports excluded; second sampled noisy passes are not multiplied into this total.

retention.included: All completed remote manifests and workspace SHA-256 hashes; scores, reports, technical logs, exact executed Python/C++ sources and current study source; local test and diagnostic evidence.
retention.excluded: Full completed workspace files (about 6.68 GB), incomplete temporary arrays (about 0.255 GB), and unrelated repository source; all cloud account, endpoint, credentials, billing and screenshot metadata.
retention.local_representatives: Ignored local-evidence/triad-v3-weak/representative retains balanced pairs from seven profiles/shards, plus local development workspaces.
retention.regeneration: Checkout base_commit, apply current-source/tracked-source.patch, overlay current-source/tools and tests; inspect remote/executed-source for the exact executed Python snapshots and campaign manifests for C++ source hashes. Full sample workspaces require regeneration.

limits: Rate36 two-day export timed out before complete manifests; no decoding result.
Operational false-admission control assumes declared known white-noise variance; mismatch diagnostic fails.
No ordinary Robust integration or regression qualification.
